title: Elon Musk highlights mystery surrounding the search of alien life

content:
Elon Musk has raised concern about the lack of evidence of extraterrestrial life, prompting questions about why humanity has yet to detect signs of other capable civilizations beyond Earth.

The 55-year-old who leads SpaceX and operates thousands of Starlink satellites has consistently reported no proof of extraterrestrial craft or actions.

A recent post reignited the Fermi Paradox, questioning why advanced civilizations seem to have disappeared in a galaxy that could be swiftly populated.

Musk's post reads: “It troubles me greatly that we do not yet see any sign of aliens.”

The post drew compelling reactions from users with one writing, “ Elon, how can it trouble you when you know the truth and the math behind it? The distances are so vast that we may never meet. The laws of physics are hard to break. There are aliens, but by the time they get here, we might already be extinct. Or they are already here, and you cannot see them.”

Second remarked, “ You might wanna double check with this dude, who everyone knows you know very, very well. Not aliens. But non-human intelligence.”

Third added, “ Signs are everywhere. Be more specific. When you say "we" do you mean SpaceX or humanity?.”
